main:alt-voltage:
Usage: <prog>

  交替电压下发工具

  在 0V 和指定电压之间循环交替发送到 R50Power 控制器的指定单元。 可选同步采集 NI DAQ ADC 电压信号，结果自动保存为 CSV。

  Examples:

      # 全部 50 个通道交替 20V, 1Hz, 持续运行直到 Ctrl+C     python -m
      ao_shaping.runners.micro_drive.voltage_runner --ip 192.168.0.101 --voltage
      20

      # 通道 0-5 交替 30V, 2Hz, 持续 10 秒     python -m
      ao_shaping.runners.micro_drive.voltage_runner --ip 192.168.0.101 --voltage
      30 --freq 2.0 --duration 10 --channels 0,1,2,3,4,5

      # 全部通道, 0.5Hz, 跳过 ping 和自动上电     python -m
      ao_shaping.runners.micro_drive.voltage_runner --ip 192.168.0.101 --voltage
      15 --freq 0.5 --no-ping-first --no-relay-on

      # 同步采集 ADC (Dev1/ai0, 5kHz, 10 samples/read)     python -m
      ao_shaping.runners.micro_drive.voltage_runner --ip 192.168.0.101 --voltage
      20 --adc-enabled --adc-device Dev1 --adc-channel ai0

Options:
  --ip TEXT                       Controller IP address (e.g., 192.168.0.101)
                                  [required]
  --port INTEGER                  TCP port (default: 10000 + last IP octet)
  --voltage FLOAT                 Input voltage for alternation (V)  [required]
  --freq FLOAT                    Alternation frequency (Hz, default: 1.0)
  --duration FLOAT                Duration in seconds (0=until Ctrl+C, default:
                                  0)
  --channels TEXT                 Channels to alternate (comma-separated, e.g.

  --ping-first / --no-ping-first  Ping test before connecting (default: True)
  --relay-on / --no-relay-on      Auto relay on before starting (default: True)
  --debug                         Enable debug logging

                                  False)
  --adc-device TEXT               NI DAQ device name (default: Dev1)
  --adc-channel TEXT              Analog input channel (default: ai0)

main:slm-model-in-loop:
Usage: <prog>

  SLM model-in-the-loop square shaping (SLM + CCD closed loop).

  Every round: fit the forward model's aberration from measured probe frames,
  then synthesise a square far-field spot with that aberration frozen. The
  fitted phase is only adopted if it measurably beats what is already held, and
  the final phase is kept only if it beats the flat baseline.

  Exit codes:
    0  a shaped phase was adopted (or flat was correctly kept)
    2  the geometry bake-off failed, or the bench stayed outside the model --
       the run refused to commit a phase. Use slm-gs-refine for that bench.

Options:
  -r, --n-rounds INTEGER          Fit -> shape -> re-measure rounds.
  --seed INTEGER                  RNG seed for probes and phases.
  --device TEXT                   Torch device for the forward model (e.g.
                                  cpu/cuda).
  --warm-start / --no-warm-start  Warm-start each Step B solve from the previous
                                  round's phase. Turning this off restarts Step
                                  B from flat every round.
  --early-stop-score FLOAT        Stop once the measured composite reaches this
                                  (0 = run all rounds).
  --save-best-image BOOLEAN       Save the best far-field PNG.
  --show                          Open a live pygame window: measured CCD, phase
                                  on the SLM, the forward model's PREDICTED far
                                  field, and the per-round metric curve. Same
                                  flag as slm-pib / spgd-square. Closing the
                                  window stops the search after the current
                                  round.
  --target-side INTEGER           Target square side in CAMERA pixels. The bench
                                  model only sees its own far-field grid, so
                                  this is converted via the calibrated
                                  camera_px_per_model_px.
  --w-uniformity FLOAT            Weight on in-box coefficient of variation.
  --w-efficiency FLOAT            Weight on encircled energy. MUST stay non-
                                  zero: optimising -CV alone empties the target
                                  box (hardware measured EE -> 0.002).
  --probe-count INTEGER           Distinct probe phases per round. Several are
                                  cycled through ONE optimizer state because
                                  focal-plane intensity is a non-convex
                                  measurement of pupil phase; one probe leaves
                                  Adam in whichever stationary point it started
                                  in.
  --probe-spread FLOAT            Probe phase std in radians. MUST be well above
                                  ~3 rad: a flat pupil focuses to a near-delta
                                  whose intensity barely responds to a smooth
                                  low-order aberration, which makes the fit
                                  blind.
  --step-a-iterations INTEGER     Adam steps per round for Step A.
  --step-a-lr FLOAT               Adam lr for the shared aberration fit. 0.05 is
                                  the measured sweet spot for the cycling loop;
                                  0.2 diverges outright.
  --n-orders INTEGER              Max Zernike radial order fitted by Step A.
  --frozen-modes TEXT             Comma-separated 1-based Noll indices held at
                                  zero. Default '1,2,3' (piston/tip/tilt)
                                  because they are unidentifiable from a far-
                                  field INTENSITY; leaving them free put 56% of
                                  the fitted coefficient norm into those
                                  degenerate directions with no gain.
  --forward-checkpoint TEXT       Path to a train_amp best_coefficients.pt used
                                  to SEED the Step-A fit from coefficients
                                  learned offline, instead of the default all-
                                  zero start. OFF by default (None -> historical
                                  zero seed). The stored coefficients are
                                  checked against this run's geometry and a
                                  mismatch ABORTS rather than being silently
                                  ignored.
  --assume-unverified-geometry / --no-assume-unverified-geometry
                                  Required together with --forward-checkpoint:
                                  acknowledge that the checkpoint records no
                                  radius/center_crop/conserve_energy (it
                                  cannot), so they were reconstructed from
                                  defaults. Without it a checkpoint is refused
                                  rather than accepted as fully verified.
  --step-b-iterations INTEGER     Adam steps per round for Step B.
  --step-b-lr FLOAT               Adam lr on the full-pixel SLM phase.
  --region INTEGER                Forward-model pupil grid edge (model pixels).
  --wavelength-nm INTEGER         Laser wavelength (nm).
  --slm-pixel-um FLOAT            SLM pixel pitch in um.
  --camera-pixel-um FLOAT         CCD pixel pitch in um -- the bench model's
                                  measurement ANCHOR, because the measured focal
                                  scale only fixes the ratio f/p_cam.
  --panel-span-px FLOAT           Width in PANEL pixels of the region the model
                                  grid covers (= 2 x illuminated beam radius).
                                  REQUIRED for real captures: the model grid
                                  samples the pupil at panel_span_px/region
                                  times the SLM pitch, and using the SLM pitch
                                  directly makes the modelled aperture ~3.5x too
                                  small so no aperture can correlate.
  --pupil-center TEXT             Beam centre in PANEL pixels as 'x,y'. Must be
                                  MEASURED on the panel: the camera's 0-order is
                                  a different coordinate frame (on this bench
                                  the axes are swapped and the scales differ by
                                  >10x), so deriving one from the other writes
                                  the phase where the beam is not.
  --far-field-padding INTEGER     Zero-padding factor for the forward model's
                                  far field. Also the cost driver: the FFT is
                                  quadratic in the padded size. This is what
                                  sets the far-field SAMPLING, so it must match
                                  the optical geometry rather than the model
                                  grid -- on this bench an unpadded grid renders
                                  the ~27 um spot as a sub-pixel delta.
  --focal-length-m FLOAT          2f lens focal length in metres. 0 (the
                                  default) DERIVES it from the measured focal
                                  scale and --camera-pixel-um; pass a value to
                                  pin a specific lens.
  --dtype [float32|float64]       Torch dtype for the forward model.
  --n-calibration-probes INTEGER  Probe phases used for the one-off bench-
                                  geometry calibration.
  --min-geometry-correlation FLOAT
                                  Abort before shaping if the calibrated
                                  geometry's speckle correlation is below this.
                                  A mis-calibrated model makes the real spot
                                  WORSE, so this is the geometry bake-off.
  --trust-region-c-l2 FLOAT       Max L2 norm of the per-round coefficient
                                  change. Step A and Step B otherwise chase each
                                  other: the aberration absorbs part of the
                                  shaping phase and vice versa.
  --acceptance-loss-delta FLOAT   Reject a round whose Step-A loss ends above
                                  its start by more than this.
  --acceptance-score-eps FLOAT    Reject a round whose measured composite drops
                                  by more than this.
  --damp-lr-factor FLOAT          Step-A lr multiplier after a rejection.
  --max-rejection-streak INTEGER  Consecutive rejected rounds before aborting.

                                  outside the model (pupil registration, panel
                                  tilt, out-of-plane defocus) -- fall back to
                                  slm-gs-refine.
  --escalate-probe-count INTEGER  Extra probes added after a rejection.
  --max-probe-count INTEGER       Cap on the escalated probe count.
  --cam-type [daheng|miicam|sim]  CCD backend (sim = 2f-Fourier numerical
                                  simulation, no hardware).
  --cam-id INTEGER                CCD device ID.
  --exposure-time-ms FLOAT        CCD exposure in ms (0 = device default).
  --cam-size INTEGER              CCD window size in pixels.
  --slm-number INTEGER            Santec SLM device number (1-8).
  --slm-wavelength INTEGER        SLM operating wavelength (nm); 0 asks the

  --n-eval-frames INTEGER         Frames averaged per measurement.
  --settle-wait-s FLOAT           Initial LCOS settle wait (s).
  --settle-tol FLOAT              Relative stability tolerance.
  --settle-max-wait-s FLOAT       Cap on settle wait (s).
  --settle-max-discard INTEGER    Cap on discarded unstable frames before giving

  --settle-discard INTEGER        Consecutive unstable frames tolerated before a
                                  frame is taken anyway.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
